nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner, set from msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
Pending owner address used by the two-step transferOwnership/acceptOwnership flow.
ERC20 token symbol string, set to NEX in the NEXToken constructor.
ERC20 token name string, set to NEXTAC in the NEXToken constructor.
ERC20 token decimals, set to 18.
Total token supply, 500000000000000000000000000 assigned in the constructor.
Mapping of account address to token balance, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping owner => spender => amount, mutated by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
SafeMath addition helper performing c = a + b with a require(c >= a) overflow check.
SafeMath subtraction helper requiring b <= a before computing c = a - b.
SafeMath multiplication helper computing c = a * b with a divisibility overflow check.
SafeMath division helper requiring b > 0 before computing c = a / b.
Owned contract constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Second step of ownership transfer; requires msg.sender == newOwner and rotates owner.
NEXToken constructor initializing metadata, total supply and the deployer balance.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using an unchecked subtraction.
Returns balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 transfer moving tokens from msg.sender to the 'to' address using SafeMath.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Spends allowance and moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' using SafeMath helpers.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract (external call).
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts to reject ETH.
onlyOwner rescue function that externally calls transfer on an arbitrary ERC20 token contract.
Callback interface function invoked on the spender contract by approveAndCall.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance ownership and allowances.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed before state is finalised in approveAndCall.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an attacker-supplied token address.
Raw addition c = a + b inside safeAdd guarded only by require(c >= a).
Raw multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul guarded only by a divisibility require.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply without SafeMath.
Unconditional revert() in the payable fallback, which can break contracts sending ETH to it.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read in the Owned constructor to initialise the owner.
owner state variable is written directly from the caller-supplied msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
transferOwnership writes the _newOwner argument into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before rotating ownership.
acceptOwnership assigns newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0) after the transfer.
NEXToken constructor fixes the _totalSupply value.
NEXToken constructor mints the whole supply into balances of the deployer address.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply in an arithmetic expression.
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
balanceOf returns an entry of the balances mapping.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
transfer mutates balances[msg.sender] and balances[to].
transfer invokes safeSub on the sender balance.
transfer invokes safeAdd on the recipient balance.
transfer uses msg.sender as the source of the balance update.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping of from and to.
transferFrom decreases allowed[from][msg.sender] via safeSub.
transferFrom calls safeSub for balance and allowance arithmetic.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the recipient balance.
transferFrom keys the allowance on the caller-controlled msg.sender.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
approveAndCall uses msg.sender as the allowance owner and forwards it to the callee.
safeAdd performs the raw addition c = a + b.
safeMul performs the raw multiplication c = a * b.
transferAnyERC20Token directs the rescued tokens to the owner state variable.
onlyOwner gates transferAnyERC20Token on msg.sender == owner.
approveAndCall performs an external contract call to the caller-supplied spender.
The external call executes receiveApproval on the untrusted spender contract, enabling reentrant state changes.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary ERC20 contract address.
The external token transfer returns funds to the privileged owner address.
The payable fallback executes revert() for every incoming call.
